name: Grumman F8F Bearcat
summary: Compact carrier fighter built around the biggest engine that would fit, the last piston fighter Grumman produced; many Bearcats race at Reno and fly in the US.

wings: Low, straight, tapered wing with a clipped look
engines: Large R-2800 radial in a big round cowl
fuselage: Short, compact fuselage with a bubble canopy
Cockpit set far forward over the wing
tail: Horizontal tail mounted on the fuselage

tellTales: Compact airframe with an oversize radial nose and a tall tail
Bubble canopy set far forward on a short fuselage
Looks like a race plane: clipped wing and tall fin

confusedWith.howToTell: The Corsair has inverted gull wings and a long nose; the Bearcat has a straight wing and a short, compact fuselage.
The Wildcat has a mid wing and a stubbier shape; the Bearcat has a low wing and a longer cowl.
The Sea Fury is longer and slimmer; the Bearcat is shorter and stubbier.
The Thunderbolt is a larger barrel-shaped airplane with a chin intake; the Bearcat is much smaller.
